headline_findings: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B plus Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B both run locally via llama-server and form the default offline recall plus rerank pair
Consensus local pipeline is tantivy BM25 plus cosine vectors fused by RRF k=60 with a tau=0.50 rejection gate and fact-level atomic chunking
sqlite-vec (exact) and LanceDB (embedded ANN plus versioning) cover the no-server store ladder; docling.rs gives a Rust-native Windows ingestion path

items.fit_reference_machine: Excellent: 0.6B Q4_K_M ~0.4GB fits 8GB VRAM alongside coder model; batch-1 CPU fallback fine; 32K ctx covers long chunks
items.harness_integration: Spawn llama-server child: -m qwen3-embedding-0.6b-q4_k_m.gguf --embedding --pooling last -ngl 99 on 127.0.0.1; allowlist those argv flags; cache vectors in SQLite
items.name: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B via llama.cpp
items.quality_cost: Top-tier 2025 MTEB (8B 70.58); 0.6B trails 4B/8B; dropping Instruct prefix costs ~1-5% retrieval
items.reported_gain: 8B scored 70.58 MTEB multilingual June 2025; 0.6B is efficiency tier; conditions: MTEB eval harness, not batch-1 laptop
items.what: 0.6B/4B/8B instruction-aware embedding family with 32K context and Matryoshka dims; llama.cpp serves it with --embedding --pooling last
items.where_implemented: Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B GGUF + llama.cpp --embedding --pooling last (support merged PR #15023)

items.fit_reference_machine: Excellent: 0.6B reranker Q4_K_M is small; per-query cross-encoding is slower than bi-encoder so cap rerank depth at 5-20 docs
items.harness_integration: Spawn second llama-server child with --reranking --alias qwen3-reranker-0.6b on another loopback port; POST query plus documents; sort by relevance_score
items.name: Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B via llama-server
items.quality_cost: Large quality lift on retrieval subsets (0.6B 65.80 MTEB-R, 67.28 MLDR); adds per-doc cross-encoder latency
items.reported_gain: 0.6B: 65.80 MTEB-R, 71.31 CMTEB-R, 67.28 MLDR, 73.42 code; 4B: 69.76 MTEB-R, 81.20 code; top-100 from Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B
items.what: Cross-encoder reranker framing relevance as softmaxed yes/no score; llama.cpp exposes it at POST /reranking behind --reranking
items.where_implemented: Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B GGUF + llama.cpp PR #15824 (commit b5bd037, Sep 2025) + --reranking server flag

items.fit_reference_machine: Excellent: a float compare plus empty-set check; zero GPU/RAM cost; directly fixes hallucinated memory recall offline
items.harness_integration: Gate every memory injection: if keyword set empty and max cosine below tau, inject nothing and let model say unknown; expose tau in config
items.name: Low-confidence rejection gate (tau=0.50)
items.quality_cost: Trades a little recall for far fewer spurious recalls; at tau 0.64 recall drops ~9pp while miss-empty hits 100%
items.reported_gain: Tau 0.50 tied best 95.7% avg Hit@1 with 62.5% miss-empty on 43 queries; FTS5 cut keyword latency 1100x at 100K rows
items.what: Reject memory recall when keyword recall is empty and max vector similarity is below threshold tau (0.50 recommended)
items.where_implemented: MemX Algorithm 1 + Section 5.3 threshold sweep over {0.48,0.50,0.52,0.64}

items.fit_reference_machine: Excellent: more small rows fit the same SQLite/LanceDB file; extraction cost is one-time and can run idle-time on CPU
items.harness_integration: Add Rust ingest step: LLM distills sessions/docs to atomic facts with source IDs; store typed facts with supersedes links; make dedup tag-aware
items.name: Fact-level atomic chunking
items.quality_cost: Doubles Hit@5/MRR vs session chunks; knowledge-update jumps most; naive tag-signature dedup can hurt tag-free facts (-5pp)
items.reported_gain: LongMemEval 500 Qs: fact storage 51.6% Hit@5 / 0.38 MRR vs 24.6% / 0.18 session-level; update queries 30.8%->75.6%
items.what: LLM-extracted atomic facts as the retrieval unit instead of whole sessions or turns; semantic density per record drives quality
items.where_implemented: MemX LongMemEval study: session 19K vs round 100K vs fact 220K records (DeepSeek-Chat extraction)
